title: Complete the per-activity retry-interval map in Technical Decisions #5
description:
spec_v1.md § Open Questions & Decisions Needed → Technical Decisions #5 gives the retry interval map as: 'bronze_wgi is 0 retries — its 30s interval is retained but inert; 30s for bronze_epi, 120s for bronze_to_silver_cleaning/silver_to_gold/data_quality_checks, 300s for the four Copy activities.' That enumerates 9 of the pipeline's 10 activities. The omitted one is pipeline_error_handler (retry 0, retryIntervalInSeconds 30), measured 2026-08-21 from fabric/orchestrator_pipeline_bronze_to_gold.DataPipeline/pipeline-content.json.

The corrected '0-3 retries' range is already right, and docs/error_handling_strategy.md already names both zero-retry activities ('bronze_wgi and pipeline_error_handler are 0'). Only the spec's own interval map is incomplete, so the spec is currently less complete than the doc it fronts.

DO: add pipeline_error_handler (0 retries, 30s interval) to the map. Per DEC-016 this is a substantive spec text edit and MUST route through /iterate — do not edit spec_v1.md directly. NOTE: /iterate carries disable-model-invocation, so Erik must type it.
acceptanceCriteria: Technical Decisions #5's interval map enumerates all 10 pipeline activities, including pipeline_error_handler (0 retries, 30s).
The edit lands via /iterate, not by direct edit of spec_v1.md.

issues.description: Residual FR-103-cluster error that the sweep missed: spec_v1.md:1455 (§ Business Logic & Calculations → DAX Measures) says 'Total Spend by Country = spend rolled to supplier HQ country'. The measure is SUM(fact_procurement[spend_eur]) (fact_procurement.tmdl:30), and gold_dim_country relates only through production_country_key, so it rolls to PRODUCTION country; dax_measure_library.md:80 agrees. Now contradicts the corrected Country Relationships note. Predates this task (2eece5b, 2026-08-06); needs an /iterate fix.

Ambiguous wording, not a contradiction: § Orchestration's 'Retry: 2 attempts' (lines 662, 673) and 'Retry: 1 attempt' (686) are correct read as retries (JSON 2/2/1), but TD#5 defines 'N retries, i.e. N+1 total attempts'. Predates this task.
Docs drift outside this task: docs/error_recovery_playbook.md:26 gives pipeline_error_handler's interval as '—' (JSON: 30); line 22 spells the activity 'bronze_EPI' (actual: bronze_epi).
For information: the spec diff also carries the FR-103 relationship edits (lines 783, 787, 794–797, 804, 908) — outside task-081's criteria, same approved /iterate pass, all re-derived as accurate.
